baseline.name: Linear maximum scan
baseline.approach: Inspect every value to locate the largest element in a valid mountain array.

why: A rising midpoint slope excludes the left half, while a falling slope retains the midpoint as a possible peak.
quantitative_comparison: Each loop reduces the candidate interval to at most about half its former size, yielding at most ceil(log2(n)) iterations, versus n-1 comparisons in a full maximum scan. This is a comparison model, not elapsed timing.
tradeoffs: Only valid strict mountain inputs justify the elimination rule. Small arrays and cache behavior can change observed timing; the function does not validate the mountain property.
evidence_basis: Static interval-size recurrence for the captured source; no paired benchmark.
